name: @latticekit/example-orbit
description: ORBIT — a gallery exhibit. No ground at all: platforms, stars, and a cold palette.
$comment: Six of nine. `sim`, `persist` and `audio` are absent: there is no economy in orbit, nothing here outlives the tab, and the silence is the palette. The one idea is `draw.palette` — that a kit whose defaults are grass and daylight recolors to a cold void without a single new primitive.
